about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a Full Stack Web Developer with a Higher Technical degree in Web Application Development (DAW), over a year of hands-on experience at Servibyte S.L., and the solo author of Between, a live production product with real users.
about.p2: I use AI as an engineering instrument, not a shortcut: I write the specification first, direct the implementation, and verify every piece before it ships. That's how I took Between — game mechanics, security, and privacy/terms policy included — from idea to production in about three weeks, solo and on a shoestring budget: the scope that would normally take a team of 5-6 developers.
about.p3: I work with independent judgment, learn quickly, and I'm at my best on a team that reviews each other's work.
